Our Story

Meet the woman behind the brand

Meet SALAUDEEN OLUWAFUNKE WAS-EKUNDAYO OLUWAKUNKE the beautiful, confident, and stylish CEO of ArinCraft World a graceful African woman with glowing skin, elegant braided hair, and a soft, warm smile. Dressed in a classy cream outfit and luxurious gold accessories, she embodies excellence and refined taste.

She is a successful, approachable, and visionary businesswoman who has built a brand known for unique, high-quality handbags. Doing business with ArinCraft World means working with a woman of integrity, style, and excellence.
